_comment: Per-castaway prior features. All values 0..1 unless noted.
phys    = physical/challenge value. High phys lowers pre-merge boot risk, RAISES post-merge risk.
social  = read-people / bond-building proxy. High social lowers boot risk everywhere.
threat  = perceived strategic or winner threat. Mildly lowers pre-merge risk, raises post-merge risk.
phys/social/threat are SUBJECTIVE pre-season priors from bio data only (age + occupation). Weak.
preseason_buzz = -1..1, same sign convention as the in-season 'edit' signal (+ = doomed-looking,
- = protected/favoured). Unlike phys/social/threat this is NOT a bio guess - it is read from
named, dated, cited pre-season predictions. Where two sources both judge a castaway their
scores are AVERAGED, so a single pundit cannot drive the model and disagreement shrinks the
signal toward zero. Sources, checked 2026-09-17 and 2026-09-22:
- Idol Speculation, 'Survivor 51 Cast Assessment', 2026-08-28
https://idolspeculation.wordpress.com/2026/08/28/idol-speculation-survivor-51-cast-assessment/
Full-cast assessment: winner picks (Aaliyah primary, Devin second, Sharonda dark horse),
a named first-boot pick (Linnea), a pre-merge-boot list (11 names), and deep-run/finale
picks (Ana, Kilby, Carter, Eric, Ori, Patt). Scored -0.30..+0.30 by how strong the call is.
- Inside Survivor, 'Survivor 51 Draft and Cast Assessment', checked 2026-09-22
https://insidesurvivor.com/survivor-51-draft-and-cast-assessment-61686
Strong contenders (Mike, Jelly, Alexis, Carter) -0.25; moderate (Thien An, Sharonda,
Jenna) -0.10; early-boot risks (Lewis, Maggie) +0.25. Disagrees with Idol Speculation on
Mike, Alexis and Jelly, which is why those three now sit near zero instead of doomed.
- Yahoo, 'Who's most likely to win Survivor 51 based on their occupation?', checked 2026-09-17
https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/tv/articles/whos-most-likely-win-survivor-224931211.html
Historical winner-occupation data favouring business/medical/police/fire roles; names
Cristian (HR) and Mike (baseball ops exec). Applied at half weight (-0.05) as a structural
base rate rather than a judgement about these people.
No Survivor 51 prediction-market (Polymarket/Kalshi) odds exist yet as of 2026-09-17 - those sites
only had markets for already-aired seasons (48-50). Checked and confirmed absent, not just unchecked.
Treat preseason_buzz as ONE source's pre-season opinion, not knowledge: it is deliberately capped at
+-0.30, well inside the +-1.0 range 'edit' uses for real in-episode evidence, and it should be the
first thing overwritten once real edit signals exist after episode 1 - see docs/PLAYBOOK.md.
Episode edit data overwrites all of this - see docs/PLAYBOOK.md. Do not treat any of it as knowledge.
Season-shape and event-frequency ASSUMPTIONS the draft board needs to turn the
site's per-action point values (scoring.json) into expected points. None of these
are on the site. All are confidence: low. Calibrate them from the standings
'Survivor' column once episodes 1-2 are scored: that column is exactly the
points each player's two drafted castaways earned, so it measures these rates.

_notes.finalists: new-era seasons end in a final 3; the 'open era' could change this
_notes.merge_at_players: new-era merges happen at about 12-13 players left
_notes.own_phys_tribe_tilt: a castaway is 1 of ~10 on a tribe, so their own physicality moves the tribe's win chance only a little; tribe challenge points go to EVERY member
_notes.tribe_reward_fraction: share of pre-merge episodes with a separately scored tribe reward; new-era seasons often combine or skip rewards
_notes.reward_companions: individual reward winners usually bring 1-2 others; the rules pay each companion 1 point
_notes.camp_points_per_episode: tree mail + water well + fire + food, summed over the whole cast per episode
_notes.advantage_points_per_episode: clue/idol/advantage/journey points over the whole cast per episode; 'every past twist returns' in the open era

weights._comment: Hazard weights. Positive weight => feature RAISES boot risk.
